definitions.explanation: Music from Western countries, especially pop, rock, and other popular genres from the English-speaking world. Used in contrast to {邦楽|ほうがく} (Japanese music).

examples.japanese: {洋楽|ようがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I often listen to Western music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧{洋楽|ようがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はまった。
examples.english: I got hooked on Western music when I was in high school.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洋楽|ようがく}⟦ヒット→ヒット：11161_hitto⟧⟦チャート→チャート：11042_chaato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}しています→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
examples.english: This program introduces the latest Western music hit charts.

notes:
USAGE:
Used broadly to refer to music from Western countries, particularly English-language popular music. The term pairs with ⟦{邦楽|ほうがく}→邦楽：14456_hougaku⟧ (Japanese music) as a basic categorization in music shops, streaming services, and media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋楽|ようがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧ (to listen to Western music)
- {洋楽|ようがく}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧ (Western music fan)
- {洋楽|ようがく}⟦チャート→チャート：11042_chaato⟧ (Western music chart)
- {洋楽|ようがく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{邦楽|ほうがく}→邦楽：14456_hougaku⟧ (Western and Japanese music)
